name: Sub-agents
description: Delegation: spawn background minimal-agent workers, steer them, review their work, fold results back. A worker is a real headless agent process with its own session id, supervised by a 1s heartbeat that reaps exits, paints a live fleet widget, and injects each finished worker's distilled result between turns. State lives at ~/.minimal-agent/sessions/<leadSid>.subagents.jsonl. Disable with MINIMAL_AGENT_DISABLE_SUBAGENTS=1.

tool.name: SpawnAgent
tool.description: Delegate a self-contained unit of work to a background sub-agent and get an immediate handle (it runs concurrently; you are NOT blocked). Use it to keep verbose work (searching, running tests, fetching docs, a focused refactor) out of your own context: the worker does it in its own window and returns only a distilled summary. Give a DETAILED task: the objective, the exact file/scope boundaries, and the output you want back. Match worker count to complexity (1 for a simple lookup, 2-4 for a comparison, more only for genuinely independent breadth-first work) — every worker costs tokens. Pick a named `agent` specialist when one fits, else describe an inline `system`. The worker reports a one-line digest between turns when it finishes; pull its full deliverable with AgentResult.

task.description: The delegation prompt: a clear objective, the scope/file boundaries the worker must stay inside, and the exact output you want back. The single biggest lever on whether delegation succeeds. Required.

agent.description: A named specialist to use: explorer (fast read-only search), planner (read-only research+plan), worker (general implementer), reviewer (read-only diff review), integrator (gate + commit). Omit to describe an inline worker via `system`.

system.description: Inline system prompt defining the worker's role, used when `agent` is omitted. Folded above the task.

model.description: Model id for the worker (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-8). Defaults to the specialist's model, else Haiku (cheap + fast for bounded delegated work).

effort.description: Reasoning effort for the worker (low|medium|high|xhigh|max), if the model supports it.

isolation.description: Context tier. `fresh` (default): a clean context with only the task + the worker's system prompt — maximum context compression. `fork`: inherit this conversation's full history (shares the prompt cache, sees your context) for a side task that needs the background without re-explaining.

label.description: Short display name for the worker in the fleet widget. Defaults to the agent type.

taskId.description: Link this worker to a task from the Task tool (its #hash). When the worker finishes the linked todo is ticked done automatically (or canceled with a reason if the worker fails). Use it to make a worker own one of your todos.

budget.description: Optional runtime budget. The supervisor stops a worker that exceeds it.

tool.name: ListAgents
tool.description: List this session's sub-agents at a glance: id, type, status, elapsed, tokens, and what each is doing. Cheap and bounded — pulls no worker transcript. Use it to see the fleet before pulling a result or stopping a worker.

tool.name: AgentStatus
tool.description: Detail for one sub-agent (status, progress, model, isolation, linked session), or the whole fleet when no id is given. No transcript.

id.description: The sub-agent handle (e.g. A2). Omit for the whole fleet.

tool.name: AgentResult
tool.description: Pull a finished sub-agent's distilled deliverable into your context (its result summary + any artifact references — NOT its full transcript). This is the only sub-agent tool that carries real worker content back, and it is bounded. Call it after a worker reaches `done`.

tool.name: AgentOutput
tool.description: Tail a sub-agent's recent activity (its latest tool calls and notes with timestamps), for 'what is A2 doing right now' beyond the one-line fleet widget. Bounded — never the whole transcript. Use sparingly; the widget and the between-turns digest usually suffice.

tool.name: Mailbox
tool.description: Coordinate with sibling sub-agents (and the lead) over a shared, durable message board. `post` a short message to a specific worker id (`to`) or broadcast to all (`to:"*"`); `read` messages addressed to you or broadcast. Opt-in and bounded: use ONLY when your task tells you to coordinate (e.g. claim a file before editing it, flag a blocker, hand off a finding). Do not chatter — excessive cross-talk is a known failure mode.

action.description: post a message, or read your messages. Default read.

to.description: Recipient: a worker id (e.g. A3) or "*" for broadcast. Default broadcast. (post only)

kind.description: Short category: note | claim | blocker | handoff. Default note. (post only)

body.description: The message text. Required for post.

since.description: ISO timestamp cursor: read only messages newer than this. (read only)

tool.name: StopAgent
tool.description: Cancel a running sub-agent by id (signals its process, marks it stopped). Use when a worker is no longer needed, was superseded, or is going off track.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded on the handle.
